name: Woodcut Tale
description: A two-colour woodcut print come to life: cream paper, bold black ink shapes with white carved hatching inside them, a red second colour slightly out of register, ink speckle and paper grain, with old-style serif captions in a carved border.
style: Two inks only (black #1a1410, red #b8322a) on cream paper, red layer 3 px out of register, carved hatching inside every inked shape, stiff 8 fps flipbook motion with a tiny jitter, paper-wipe scene changes, IM Fell English captions in a carved double-line border, the moral printed in red small caps.
